22class _ScpiMockServer(socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer):
23 allow_reuse_address = True
24
25 def __init__(self, server_address, request_handler_class):
26 super().__init__(server_address, request_handler_class)
27 self.commands: list[str] = []
28 self._lock = threading.Lock()
29
30 def push_command(self, command: str) -> None:
31 with self._lock:
32 self.commands.append(command)
33
34 def get_commands(self) -> list[str]:
35 with self._lock:
36 return list(self.commands)
37
38 def clear_commands(self) -> None:
39 with self._lock:
40 self.commands.clear()
41
42
43class _ScpiHandler(socketserver.BaseRequestHandler):
44 def handle(self) -> None:
45 buffer = b""
46 while True:
47 chunk = self.request.recv(4096)
48 if not chunk:
49 return
50 buffer += chunk
51
52 while b"\n" in buffer:
53 line, buffer = buffer.split(b"\n", 1)
54 command = line.decode("ascii", errors="replace").strip()
55 if not command:
56 continue
57
58 self.server.push_command(command) # type: ignore[attr-defined]
59 response = self._response_for(command)
60 if response is not None:
61 self.request.sendall(response.encode("ascii"))
62
63 @staticmethod
64 def _response_for(command: str) -> str | None:
65 if command == "*IDN?":
66 return "KEYSIGHT,N6705B,MY00000001,B.00.00\n"
67 if command == "SYST:CHAN?":
68 return "+4\n"
69 if command == "MEAS:VOLT? (@1)":
70 return "+5.000000E+00\n"
71 if command == "MEAS:CURR? (@1)":
72 return "+1.000000E+00\n"
73 if command == "MEAS:POW? (@1)":
74 return "+5.000000E+00\n"
75 if command == "MEAS:VOLT? (@2)":
76 return "+3.000000E+00\n"
77 if command == "MEAS:CURR? (@2)":
78 return "+2.000000E+00\n"
79 if command == "VOLT? (@1)":
80 return "+5.000000E+00\n"
81 if command == "CURR? (@1)":
82 return "+1.000000E+00\n"
83 if command == "VOLT? MIN,(@1)":
84 return "+0.000000E+00\n"
85 if command == "VOLT? MAX,(@1)":
86 return "+2.000000E+01\n"
87 if command == "CURR? MIN,(@1)":
88 return "+0.000000E+00\n"
89 if command == "CURR? MAX,(@1)":
90 return "+5.000000E+00\n"
91 if command == "OUTP? (@1)":
92 return "1\n"
93 return None
94

96class ScpiClientIntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
97 @classmethod
98 def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
99 cls.server = _ScpiMockServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), _ScpiHandler)
100 cls.server_thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
101 cls.server_thread.start()
102 cls.host, cls.port = cls.server.server_address
103
104 @classmethod
105 def tearDownClass(cls) -> None:
106 cls.server.shutdown()
107 cls.server.server_close()
108 cls.server_thread.join(timeout=2.0)
109
110 def setUp(self) -> None:
111 self.server.clear_commands()
112
113 def test_query_idn(self) -> None:
114 client = ScpiTcpClient(host=self.host, port=self.port, timeout_s=1.0)
115 client.connect()
116 try:
117 response = client.query("*IDN?")
118 finally:
119 client.disconnect()
120
121 self.assertIn("N6705B", response)
122 self.assertEqual(self.server.get_commands()[-1], "*IDN?")
123
124 def test_write_sends_scpi_command_line(self) -> None:
125 client = ScpiTcpClient(host=self.host, port=self.port, timeout_s=1.0)
126 client.connect()
127 try:
128 client.write("OUTP ON,(@1)")
129 time.sleep(0.05)
130 finally:
131 client.disconnect()
132
133 self.assertIn("OUTP ON,(@1)", self.server.get_commands())
134
135 def test_driver_measure_channels(self) -> None:
136 client = ScpiTcpClient(host=self.host, port=self.port, timeout_s=1.0)
137 instrument = N6705PowerAnalyzer(client)
138 instrument.connect()
139 try:
140 samples = instrument.measure_channels([1])
141 finally:
142 instrument.disconnect()
143
144 self.assertEqual(len(samples), 1)
145 sample = samples[0]
146 self.assertEqual(sample.channel, 1)
147 self.assertAlmostEqual(sample.voltage_v, 5.0, places=6)
148 self.assertAlmostEqual(sample.current_a, 1.0, places=6)
149 self.assertAlmostEqual(sample.power_w, 5.0, places=6)
150
151 def test_driver_reports_channel_count(self) -> None:
152 client = ScpiTcpClient(host=self.host, port=self.port, timeout_s=1.0)
153 instrument = N6705PowerAnalyzer(client)
154 instrument.connect()
155 try:
156 count = instrument.get_channel_count()
157 finally:
158 instrument.disconnect()
159
160 self.assertEqual(count, 4)
161
162 def test_driver_measure_channels_falls_back_when_power_query_not_supported(self) -> None:
163 client = ScpiTcpClient(host=self.host, port=self.port, timeout_s=1.0)
164 instrument = N6705PowerAnalyzer(client)
165 instrument.connect()
166 try:
167 samples = instrument.measure_channels([2])
168 finally:
169 instrument.disconnect()
170
171 self.assertEqual(len(samples), 1)
172 sample = samples[0]
173 self.assertEqual(sample.channel, 2)
174 self.assertAlmostEqual(sample.voltage_v, 3.0, places=6)
175 self.assertAlmostEqual(sample.current_a, 2.0, places=6)
176 self.assertAlmostEqual(sample.power_w, 6.0, places=6)
177
178 def test_driver_channel_limits_queries(self) -> None:
179 client = ScpiTcpClient(host=self.host, port=self.port, timeout_s=1.0)
180 instrument = N6705PowerAnalyzer(client)
181 instrument.connect()
182 try:
183 v_min = instrument.get_voltage_min_limit(1)
184 v_max = instrument.get_voltage_max_limit(1)
185 i_min = instrument.get_current_min_limit(1)
186 i_max = instrument.get_current_max_limit(1)
187 finally:
188 instrument.disconnect()
189
190 self.assertAlmostEqual(v_min, 0.0, places=6)
191 self.assertAlmostEqual(v_max, 20.0, places=6)
192 self.assertAlmostEqual(i_min, 0.0, places=6)
193 self.assertAlmostEqual(i_max, 5.0, places=6)
